content: {"paper_id":"W7123345583","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"nonnegative-matrix-factorization","exact_quote":"Constrained Symmetric Non-negative Matrix Factorization guided by Pairwise Constraint Propagation (PCSNMF)","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确将PCSNMF建立在对称非负矩阵分解（SNMF）框架上，属于以非负因子分解矩阵的方法。"},{"keyword_id":"pairwise-constraint-propagation","exact_quote":"Pairwise Constraint Propagation","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"标题直接以成对约束传播作为方法指导，摘要也说明利用成对传播算法，满足扩展must-link/cannot-link监督关系的定义。"},{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"semi-supervised clustering method","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要称该聚类方法为半监督聚类，并在SNMF框架中结合成对约束与标签信息等有限监督，符合半监督学习定义。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"utilizes two types of supervision (pairwise constraints and label information) within the SNMF framework","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要说明在SNMF框架中使用成对约束与标签信息两类监督，属于以不完整/有限监督替代充分实例级真值的实质研究条件。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
